questions.question: When Queen Athaliah tried to kill all the royal heirs, where was young Joash hidden for six years?

answers.text: In the house of the LORD

questions.question: The priest Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD, the king and the people. What did it say?

answers.text: That they would be the LORD's people
That they would never go to war again
That they would rebuild the city walls

questions.question: The priest Jehoiada wanted Queen Athaliah put to death inside the house of the LORD. True or false?
After being hidden from Queen Athaliah, how old was Joash when he became king?
